# The Weakest Link: A Model Of The Decline Of Surface Transportation Networks

## Contribution

This paper models transportation-network decline as an endogenous process arising from decentralized traveler and link-owner decisions. By iteratively removing the weakest link, the simulation traces how network efficiency and social welfare change and shows that a smaller, degenerated network can under some conditions outperform the inherited network.
